questions.q: What is the capital of Afghanistan?
questions.why: It sits about 1,800 m above sea level.

questions.q: Which giant Buddha statues were destroyed in 2001?
questions.why: They had stood for about 1,500 years.

questions.q: Which group took control of Afghanistan in 1996 and again in 2021?
questions.why: Their rule ended in 2001 and returned 20 years later.

questions.q: Which pass connects Afghanistan and Pakistan?
questions.why: It has been a trade and invasion route for centuries.

questions.q: Which country invaded Afghanistan in 1979?
questions.why: It withdrew in 1989.

questions.q: Which empire's founder, Ahmad Shah Durrani, is called the father of Afghanistan?
questions.why: He founded it in 1747.

questions.q: Which Afghan lion of Panjshir fought the Soviets and the Taliban?
questions.why: He was killed two days before 9/11.

questions.q: Which three wars did Britain fight in Afghanistan between 1839 and 1919?
questions.why: The third led to full independence in 1919.

questions.q: Which king ruled Afghanistan from 1933 to 1973?
questions.why: He was overthrown by his cousin.

questions.q: Which reforming king won independence in 1919?
questions.why: Independence Day is 19 August.

questions.q: Which medieval empire of Mahmud raided India from Afghanistan?
questions.why: Ghazni was its capital.

questions.q: Which 1893 line forms the border with Pakistan?
questions.why: Afghanistan has never formally accepted it.

questions.q: Which Sufi poet was born in Balkh in 1207?
questions.why: He later lived in Konya, Turkey.

questions.q: Which ancient Greek city was found at Ai-Khanoum?
questions.a: A Hellenistic city of Alexander's successors
questions.why: It had a theatre and gymnasium.

questions.q: Which minaret in Ghor province is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: It is about 65 m tall.

questions.q: What is Afghanistan's currency?
questions.why: It was introduced in 1925.

questions.q: Which mountains run across Afghanistan?
questions.why: Its name may mean 'Hindu killer'.

questions.q: Which blue stone has been mined in Badakhshan for thousands of years?
questions.why: It was used in Tutankhamun's mask.

questions.q: Which rice dish with carrots and raisins is the national dish?
questions.why: It is often served with lamb.

questions.q: Which landlocked country borders Afghanistan to the east and south?
questions.why: They share a long mountain border.

questions.q: Which game of horsemen and a goat carcass is the national sport?
questions.why: Riders compete to carry the carcass to a goal.

questions.q: What are Afghanistan's two official languages?
questions.why: Dari is a form of Persian.

questions.q: Which blue-tiled shrine is in Mazar-i-Sharif?
questions.why: It is famous for white doves.

questions.q: Which lakes in Bamiyan are Afghanistan's first national park?
questions.why: They are a chain of deep blue lakes.

questions.q: Which western city is famous for its Friday Mosque and citadel?
questions.why: It was a Timurid capital.

questions.q: Which Afghan-American author wrote 'The Kite Runner'?
questions.why: It was published in 2003.

questions.q: Which narrow strip of land links Afghanistan to China?
questions.why: It is about 350 km long.

questions.q: Which dumplings are filled with leeks and topped with yoghurt?
questions.why: They are a festive dish.

questions.q: Which tunnel through the Hindu Kush links north and south?
questions.why: It was built by the Soviets in 1964.

questions.q: What is Afghanistan's highest mountain?
questions.why: It is about 7,492 m high.
